name: ACA521 [滑行道障碍物，机长心脏病]

cards.audioText: N: [Your call sign is ACA521, a flight from Wuhan to Toronto. You are at Gate 232, you have got the latest ATIS T, contact Wuhan Delivery and request ATC clearance.]
cards.audioTextZh: 你的呼号是加航521，从武汉飞往多伦多。你现在在232机位，你收到最新通播T，联系武汉放行，请求管制许可。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Delivery, ACA521, Gate 232 with information T, request ATC clearance to Toronto.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉放行，加航521，232机位，通播T，请求飞往多伦多的管制许可。

cards.audioText: C: ACA521, Wuhan Delivery, Cleared to Toronto via flight planned route, departure runway 04, initial climb to 1500m, ZF-05 departure, cruising level 10400m, request level change en route, departure frequency 125.75, squawk 5655.
cards.audioTextZh: 加航521，北京放行，可以经由计划航路飞往多伦多，离场跑道04，初始爬升至1500米，ZF05离场，巡航高度10400米，入航后变更高度，离场频率125.75，应答机5655。
cards.referenceText: Cleared to Toronto via flight planned route, departure runway 04, initial climb to 1500m, ZF-05 departure, cruising level 10400m, request level change en route, departure frequency 125.75, squawk 5655, ACA521.
cards.referenceTextZh: 可以经由计划航路飞往多伦多，离场跑道04，初始爬升至1500米，ZF05离场，巡航高度10400米，入航后变更高度，离场频率125.75，应答机5655，加航521。

cards.audioText: N: [Now you have completed push-back and startup. You are ready to taxi, contact Wuhan Ground.]
cards.audioTextZh: 你现在完成了推出开车。你准备好滑行，联系武汉地面。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, ACA521, push-back and startup completed, request taxi.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，加航521，完成推出开车，请求滑行。

cards.audioText: C: ACA521, taxi to holding point runway 04 via taxiway Z4, A3 and A, hold short of E5.
cards.audioTextZh: 加航521，经由滑行道Z4，A3和A，滑行到跑道04外等待点，在E5等待。
cards.referenceText: Taxi to holding point runway 04 via taxiway Z4, A3 and A, hold short of E5, ACA521.
cards.referenceTextZh: 经由滑行道Z4，A3和A，滑行到跑道04外等待点，在E5等待，加航521。

cards.audioText: N: [Now you see there is an obstruction ahead of you on taxiway A3. You confirm the taxi instructions with Wuhan Ground.]
cards.audioTextZh: 在前方滑行道A3上，你看到了一个障碍物，你想与武汉地面证实滑行指令。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, ACA521, obstruction ahead on taxiway A3, confirm taxi instructions.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，加航521，滑行道A3上有障碍物，证实滑行指令。

cards.audioText: C: ACA521, hold at present position, the ground personnel will deal with it.
cards.audioTextZh: 加航521，当前位置等待，地面人员将会处理。
cards.referenceText: Roger, hold at present position, ACA521.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，当前位置等待，加航521。

cards.audioText: C: ACA521, the obstruction has been removed, continue taxi via A3, A to holding point runway 04.
cards.audioTextZh: 加航521，障碍物已被移除，继续沿A3和A滑行至跑道04外等待点。
cards.referenceText: Continue taxi via A3, A to holding point runway 04, ACA521.
cards.referenceTextZh: 继续沿A3和A滑行至跑道04外等待点，加航521。

cards.audioText: N: [Now you are holding at holding point E5, runway 04, you are fully ready, contact Wuhan Tower.]
cards.audioTextZh: 你现在在跑道04外等待点E5，你完全准备好了，联系武汉塔台。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, ACA521, holding at holding point E5, runway 04, ready for departure.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，加航521，04跑道E5等待点，请求起飞。

cards.audioText: C: ACA521, Wuhan Tower, line up and cleared for immediate takeoff, runway 04, surface wind 030 degrees, 8kts.
cards.audioTextZh: 加航521，武汉塔台，上跑道，可以立即起飞，跑道04，地面风030度，8节。
cards.referenceText: Line up and cleared for immediate takeoff runway 04, ACA521.
cards.referenceTextZh: 上跑道，可以立即起飞，跑道04，加航521。

cards.audioText: N: [Now you are airborne, you are passing 1200m, climbing to 2400m, make an initial contact with Wuhan Departure.]
cards.audioTextZh: 现在你已离地，正通过1200米上到2400米，与武汉离场建立初始联系。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Departure, ACA521, airborne, passing 1200m, climbing to 2400m.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉离场，加航521，离地了，正通过1200米上到2400米。

cards.audioText: C: ACA521, radar contact, turn right direct to ZF, climb to 4500m.
cards.audioTextZh: 加航521，雷达看见了，右转直飞ZF，上4500米。
cards.referenceText: Turn right direct to ZF, climb to 4500m ACA521.

cards.audioText: N: [Your TCAS indicates there is a conflicting traffic at 2 o'clock, 300m above your level. Confirm with Wuhan Control if it is in conflict with your aircraft.]
cards.audioTextZh: 你的TCAS指示2点钟有一架冲突航空器，在你高度层上方300米。与武汉区调证实是否与你是冲突航空器。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, ACA521, TCAS indication of traffic 2 o'clock 300m above, confirm it is a conflicting traffic.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉区调，加航521，TCAS指示2点钟方向有一架航空器，在我们上方300米，证实它是否是一架冲突航空器。

cards.audioText: C: ACA521, negative. It is parallel to your flight track.
cards.audioTextZh: 加航521，不是的，它与你航迹平行。

cards.audioText: N: [During cruise, the captain suddenly suffered from heart attack, make a distress call to Wuhan Control and request immediate return for priority landing.]
cards.audioTextZh: 在巡航时，机长突然遇到心脏病，与武汉区调进行遇险通话，请求立刻返航进行优先着陆。
cards.referenceText: Mayday Mayday Mayday, Wuhan Control, ACA521, captain heart attack, request immediate return for priority landing.
cards.referenceTextZh: Mayday Mayday Mayday，武汉区调，加航521，机长心脏病发作，请求立即返航。优先着陆。

cards.audioText: C: ACA521, roger Mayday, turn left heading 220, direct to ZF, descend to 3300m, you are No.1.
cards.audioTextZh: 加航521，收到Mayday，左转航向220，直飞ZF，下3000米，你是第一个。
cards.referenceText: Turn left heading 220, direct to ZF, descend to 3300m, No.1 ACA521.
cards.referenceTextZh: 左转航向220，直飞ZF，下3300米，第一个，加航521。

cards.audioText:
C: ACA521, What assistance do you need?
N: [Tell the controller you need an ambulance and a physician.]
cards.audioTextZh:
加航521，你需要什么样的协助？
【告知管制员，你需要救护车和医生。】
cards.referenceTextZh: 请求救护车和医生，加航521。
